answer: Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. Before the stamp comes 95 separate visits, each one billed $18 at the door, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. One name, one proof, one entry: Nominated beekeeper market writ enforces it, and a writ keepers file after hive reviews is how the check runs. The clerk notes jetty. The tally keeps copper. orchard stays on the record.
